positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Added a new game mode called TRONQuest to a project called MineBike, an interactive fitness machine that incorporates the game Minecraft with a physical bicycle. AI programs were implemented such that NPCs are able to interact with the users' heart rates and the cycling motion of the users controls characters in the game. TRONQuest was coded in Java using APIs including Minecraft Forge and Noppes NPC, as well as the Time library to manipulate internal clocks.

positions.title: Teaching Intern
positions.description: Taught high school students complex concepts in Java such as backtracking, shortest-path algorithms, spanning trees, graph traversals, and more. Worked alongside troubled students individually and prepared them for coding competitions such as the USA Computing Olympiad (USACO).

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Worked under the instruction of Dr. Kiran George in learning about and implementing Internet of Things (IoT). Implemented Arduino, ESP8266 WiFi Module, and various components to build and test prototypes for a smart backpack. Created an application and web page to update readings from Peltier plates and force-sensitive resistors in real-time.
positions.insights: Skills: Rapid Prototyping · Internet of Things (IoT)

volunteerExperiences.description: Primarily worked to manage traffic flow of people and enhance guest experience by answering questions, verbally engaging the children, or interactively teaching hands-on science concepts with the children.

Organized events and worked alongside members in a variety of ways, including cleaning parks and beaches, hosting garage sales, tutoring students, recycling, and more. We also visited orphanages to support and encourage the children there, and fundraised to provide care packages during homeless outreach events.

projects.title: Personal Dated Database
projects.description: Developed a database application in Java with a functional calendar and journal that stores and loads information in local text files. Implemented an interactive and intuitive GUI using Eclipse WindowBuilder that can be exported through executable .jar files. Also acted as the primary liaison in developing this application for a client though a series of emails over several months, discussing details regarding expectations and goals.
